explication: Home Lab Hub is a self-hosted infrastructure inventory and visualization app. Users browse and edit infrastructure records, then explore their relationships in a graph or tree; they can also manage markdown documentation and back up inventory data. The frontend routes requests through a shared API helper to Flask route handlers and SQLAlchemy-backed models. The excerpts establish several frontend calls and model relationships; some backend registrations and the export/import implementation were not sampled, so those connections are omitted or marked unverified.
